def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    btc_amount = int(next(it))
    btc_costs = [0] * 100
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    right = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if right == 0:
            left = int(next(it))
        else:
            left = right
            right = 0
        if left % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd and i != n - 1:
            right = int(next(it))
            btc_cost = abs(left - right)
            btc_costs[btc_cost] += 1
            even = 0
            odd = 0
    sawed_amount = 0
    current_btc_cost = 0
    for i in range(100):
        for j in range(btc_costs[i]):
            current_btc_cost += i
            if current_btc_cost <= btc_amount:
                sawed_amount += 1
            else:
                break
    print(sawed_amount)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
